# Mishka UI source attribution

Source and complete file/adaptation inventory: documents/reference/upstream-mishka.md
in the ConnectorX source distribution; the same inventory is bundled as
assets/licenses/upstream-mishka.md.

ConnectorX incorporates the appearance/theme screen, configuration, labels,
selected localized strings, cards, layout, blur, navigation and liquid-glass
components from the fixed Mishka revision recorded in that inventory.

Mishka's project license is GNU GPL version 3; see Mishka-GPL-3.0.txt.
Files with explicit Apache-2.0 headers retain those headers. Liquid-glass
sources retain compose-miuix-ui and Kyant0/AndroidLiquidGlass credits;
see Apache-2.0.txt.

Adaptations include namespace/resource substitutions, isolated appearance
preferences and Android application/session integration. The product's four
navigation destinations are application, device, automation and settings.
The appearance/theme screen body and corresponding wording are preserved
from the reference source except namespace and attribution substitutions.

This notice does not declare a new license for unrelated original code.
Distribution of the combined work must respect applicable imported source
licenses, including GPL source obligations. These notices are generated into
APK assets from the maintained third_party/licenses source directory.
